A2.reason: The A1 rehearsal expires once the promotion has run, so only a rehearsal taken at A2 can show that the promotion is still reversible for C7 after the staging area is tidied.

C9.for_what_part: The confirmed sending calls, with their recipient and wording fingerprints checked against the release, and the count of calls ordered but not confirmed. A call that is not in the record is not shown.

parsed.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted a live-table check of the category rule (C3), which no instrument in the library gives. I would also have wanted a per-read check that the worker reads only approved accounts (C5), and a check that every sending call left its outbox row (C10), across all 100 customers. Scope of a call and trace of a call are priced at 10 per named line and cannot be put in a plan, and the allowance of 50 covers at most five lines, so C5 and C10 can only be sampled during the work. The A1 undo rehearsal goes stale once the promotion runs, so C7 needs the A2 rehearsal at 66, which leaves little of the 200 cap for anything else.
